sample_rows: Five original samples per reuse/stream cell,in repetition order0..4. Work per pass=100*group jobs;NT histograms,distinct weight extents and real model slices derive from the frozen plan.

analysis.method: ms/job=median(wall_s/(passes*100*group))*1000. Ratios use these per-cell medians. GU fraction=median(gu_s/wall_s). Read GB/s=median(requested_bytes/wall_s)/1e9. Requested bytes are logical visits,not measured physical traffic.
analysis.decision: Use the dominant-format CPU GU path as a next source/implementation question,alongside the separately pending Q6_K MTP-head calibration. This calibration does not adopt any inference change.
limits: 1-to6 compute-thread scaling is2.69..4.10x at28-job stream. For six of seven format pairs,the6-job stream/reuse median latency ratio is1.014..1.098;IQ4_XS is1.563. This disfavors pure aggregate RAM bandwidth as a sufficient explanation,but does not identify instruction,lookup,cache-port or synchronization saturation.
GU is65..81% of the28-job six-thread pool wall;these clocks include scheduling/waiting and are not arithmetic service or hardware occupancy.
IQ3_S/IQ4_NL and IQ4_XS/IQ4_NL stream28 five-sample max/min ratios are1.458 and1.482. A fine comparison for these cells needs a fresh repeated plan;original samples are not replaced.
Marginal NT mix,synthetic finite activations and fixed6/28 job counts approximate the request;actual trace,residency/reuse and GPU overlap are not replayed.
Read-only median achieved references are30.642GB/s at1 thread and29.403GB/s at6. They are not physical DRAM bandwidth measurements or upper bounds.
No GPU work,no PCIe/VRAM traffic measurement,no clean model gain,sustained decode,task-quality or physical-context qualification.

retention_consumer: CPU resource/kernel decision and focused repetition if needed. Keep useful individual samples;original full framing/work/timers are recoverable at full_result.commit. Review at that decision;auxiliary raw/build already retired.
